text: Start Again luxury gym brand. 6-second ending shot: two athletes on a sunset rooftop gym leap up through clouds and assemble a metallic S logo. Reference images: rooftop scene (image_0), logo (image_2), athlete sheet (image_4).
Rooftop fitness ad, two men, both holding silver dumbbells, visible sweat, cinematic lighting. Camera reveals the rest of the class.
Skincare serum UGC: woman applies the serum in a bathroom mirror and shows the bottle label to camera.
Coffee maker product ad: hands-only, morning kitchen, pour into a mug, steam visible. Logo must stay readable.
Running shoes ad: one runner on a city street at dawn, close-ups of shoes striking the pavement.
Protein bar UGC: a student in a dorm opens the bar, takes a bite, reacts. Wrapper branding must stay visible.
Backpack lifestyle ad: two friends hiking, one adjusts the straps and shows the zipper pocket.
Wireless earbuds product ad: single person on a train puts in earbuds, tapping the case. Case must stay in frame.
Macro product shot of a white sneaker rotating slowly on a pedestal, studio lighting, no people.
